name: DragonSwordWorldRadar
source_baseline: 0.4.0-dev30-referencecache1 (owner-accepted performance baseline; later fresh-Pawn travel safety retained)
renderer: WinForms source compiled in memory by Windows PowerShell 5.1
automatic_start: per-session hidden WScript watcher launched by the UE4SS mod; host, overlay, and watcher bind to and exit with the exact game process

scheduler.motion_xy_threshold_game_units: max(20, radius / 170 * 0.5); approximately 36.8 town and 66.2 field
scheduler.policy: preserve dev43 epoch-bounded widget and loop ownership plus dev42 install-bound save RVA; use one fresh player scalar per 250 ms, 50 ms compact presentation, and diagnostic 4 ms visible-world-map presentation

platform_timing.false_behavior: use the Windows default outside the world map; request one balanced timeBeginPeriod(1) only while the expanded map is visible
platform_timing.true_behavior: request timeBeginPeriod(1) for the Overlay process and balance it with timeEndPeriod(1) on close
platform_timing.lifecycle: the startup-wide option remains restart-scoped; when it is false, world-map-only acquisition is idempotent and released on exit, suppression, disable, or close

world_transition_lifecycle.entry: a missing or failed cached Engine -> current Controller -> current Pawn sample increments the world epoch, disables UObject work, invalidates queued callbacks, purges cached Engine/minimap/provider handles, and publishes a disabled bridge frame; Pawn wrappers are never retained and UE4SS LoadMap hooks are intentionally not registered
world_transition_lifecycle.recovery: Pawn/root loss starts a three-second fail-closed cooldown with zero UObject access; cooldown expiry releases one normal cached-Engine/current-Controller/current-Pawn location sample, and every failed sample rearms the complete cooldown without GetWorld or GetFullName identity probing
world_transition_lifecycle.stale_work: every game-thread motion, world-map, and control callback captures and validates the current world epoch before UObject access; the former dedicated recovery callback is removed
world_transition_lifecycle.controls: F7 releases one normal location probe only when no cooldown remains; F8 cancels deferred activation and invalidates the epoch immediately
world_transition_lifecycle.runtime_acceptance: pending repeated in-game dungeon, teleport, story-mode, minimap, and expanded-map validation

render_surface_visibility.sampling: the existing 250 ms game-thread control callback reads minimap scale at most once per second; cached Engine and DLayerMiniMap wrappers are resolved only when absent/invalid, with no UObject enumeration or additional worker
render_surface_visibility.compact_visible: no game-HUD visibility UObject query is performed; compact presentation follows player-context/master-enable plus the Overlay foreground/minimize policy, exactly matching the supplied 1.6.1 reference
render_surface_visibility.compact_hidden: task/cutscene minimap absence is not inferred from UObject visibility; player-context loss or F8 publishes the existing fail-closed disabled bridge frame
render_surface_visibility.world_map: expanded world-map detection occurs first and remains independent of compact minimap visibility
render_surface_visibility.runtime_acceptance: pending startup, travel, task/cutscene, expanded-map, smoothness, and object-lookup-frequency validation

marker_rendering: one unified Boss/Assault encounter traversal plus direct retained-geometry marker drawing on every paint; no bitmap or layer cache

treasure_selection.source: packaged-dev15 WorldTreasureVisibilityIndex and query buffer over map 100 after save-open filtering; expanded world map uses frame WorldMap.mapId

persistent_completion.mole_cross_restart: provided by the existing external tb_treasure_box snapshot; claimed same-ID rewards stay hidden across restarts
persistent_completion.encounters: nine Bosses and forty current-PAK Assault targets form one startup-fixed 49-ID tb_actor_respawn snapshot filter and availability cache; shared daily recovery uses the observed 09:00 Korea Standard Time boundary (00:00 UTC)

runtime_ipc.static_bridge_status: removed from active runtime; legacy radar_state*.json is cleanup-only
static_bridge_removed_work: Lua JSON construction and heartbeat writes
static/motion state merge and fallback logic

window_geometry.compact: rectangular 360x400 reference pixels: 360-pixel minimap square with a six-pixel overlap into a 46-pixel status strip
window_geometry.disabled: F8, player-context loss, game foreground loss, or minimization hides the one Overlay window; no status-only presentation remains active
window_geometry.native_region: none; dev16 HRGN composition APIs removed

catalog_ownership.treasures: Overlay loads data/generated/treasures.lua and applies save filtering locally
catalog_ownership.encounters: Overlay startup validates data/generated/bosses.lua and data/generated/assaults.lua, combines exactly 9 Bosses plus 40 Assault targets, fixes one 49-ID tb_actor_respawn filter, and performs no F7 catalog load/cache reset/query-shape change
catalog_ownership.moles: Overlay loads exactly 34 MiniGame_Fly records and filters the Lua candidate mask through raw same-ID DT_MiniGame_G5 reward bits from tb_treasure_box
catalog_ownership.assaults: show_assaults controls only presentation of the 40 Assault members in the immutable encounter catalog; optional generated conditions are record-owned and fail closed when their scalar source is unavailable
catalog_ownership.lua_role: publishes only numeric scalar player/control data through protocol-v5; no Pawn/Controller wrapper crosses frames or IPC

world_map.entry: hide, resize with SWP_NOCOPYBITS, one hidden Invalidate()+Update(), then reveal immediately
world_map.exit: first missing active-map sample invalidates the world-loop token, stops production, and restores radar mode
world_map.candidate_ownership: hard cap 2; every wrapper carries capture epoch and candidate token; reset drops wrappers and bumps the token; bounded resume scan cannot re-promote retired identities while current Notify-created widgets may be admitted
world_map.accumulation_status: structural unbounded retention is removed; attribution of the reported progressive post-travel slowdown remains a runtime hypothesis pending owner acceptance

data_installation: local game PAK extraction through in-memory C# and the bundled ooz.exe decoder; datasets and Assault catalog carry the locked pre-generation fingerprint and installation rejects pre/post identity drift
game_update_detection: stored executable/PAK fingerprint checked on launch
mole_completion: Fly IDs 11001-11034 map exactly to same-ID DT_MiniGame_G5 reward treasures; claimed raw tb_treasure_box bits hide markers, bypassing treasure display overrides; no game UObject completion function is resolved or called

world_status.lifecycle: production main does not import or call world_environment
world_status.layout: compact window width 360 and height 400 reference pixels; 138-wide group centered in the 46-pixel strip overlapping the minimap by six pixels; bounds clamped; reference phase font=13
world_status.weather_status: disabled; observed values remained invariant and were not a trustworthy visible-weather source
world_status.rate_assumption: approximately 60 game seconds per real second, confirmed in research and used for local extrapolation

boss_runtime_tracking: tb_actor_respawn read from consistent .db/.bak plus WAL/SHM/journal snapshots; no Character enumeration

save_behavior.initial_visibility: fail-closed empty index until first complete save-state snapshot; first valid snapshot immediately rebuilds and publishes records not confirmed open
save_behavior.consistency: source fingerprints checked before and after snapshot copying
save_behavior.owner_pointer_rva: installer resolves one unambiguous exact-EXE PE-pattern match and persists only schema/fingerprint/executable length/RVA/provenance; runtime recomputes the current EXE+PAK fingerprint before trying generated, then known, then one delayed fallback route
save_behavior.initial_debounce: first snapshot may queue without the four-second delay because CopyConsistentSnapshot rejects source fingerprint changes before/after copy; later changes retain four seconds
save_behavior.key_discovery: verified current and legacy RVAs first; one full-image scan allowed only after 30 seconds of unresolved reads
save_behavior.runtime_gate: F8 performs no new save metadata or SQLCipher work; queued results are invalidated
save_behavior.database_cache: in-memory per .db/.bak exact fingerprint; unchanged sibling parsed snapshots are reused; no cross-restart cache
save_behavior.sqlcipher: isolated temporary snapshot connection with one key/cipher setup per connection; game save files are never opened directly by SQLCipher
save_behavior.debug_timings: copy, key, treasure query, Boss/Assault query, database reads/cache hits, total

accepted_data_rule_correction: fixed ID 10220122 is not ignored and upgrades remove only its obsolete ignore/explanation; duplicate/offset 11003 remains ignored in favor of authoritative 14016
diagnostics_output: runtime/diagnostics; pre-release defaults enable file-based debug diagnostics while diagnostic_verbose remains false; debug Lua logs separate fresh current-root traversal, K2_GetActorLocation, and every phase of the one-hertz DLayerMiniMap scale path; Overlay logs prove startup-once encounter catalog/filter ownership, unified availability, and per-type marker counts; the final release must disable debug logging
validation_status: Windows source, compile, refactor, protocol-v5, scalar scheduling/prediction, Assault isolation, Mole mapping, metadata, and package gates required; in-game smoothness and teleport behavior remain pending owner acceptance
performance_claim: No numeric FPS claim. Normal minimap UE4SS full-chain samples are reduced from about 24/s to about 4/s while retaining fresh-current-Pawn travel safety. Overlay remains 20 Hz and predicts only from two numeric samples, bounded to 250 ms and frozen after 500 ms stale age.
